consumer: The NPC dialogue gate's condition lambda built by conditional_t<T>::set_has_items (u_has_items/npc_has_items), which EVALUATES a yes/no over the alpha character actor to decide whether the door opens.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded weapon + worn + personal inventory), i.e. on-person possession, NOT the wider crafting-reachable/nearby inventory.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its body returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the dialogue character actor, which traverses visit_items (weapon+worn+inv); this is the engine-computed possession predicate the gate consumes, scoped to on-person, unlike mission::is_complete which uses the wider crafting_inventory().
divergence: The id_card lies on an adjacent floor tile (or in a nearby container) within crafting/reachable range but is NOT worn, wielded, or in the player's inventory: the correct on-person predicate returns false (gate stays closed), but a wrong authority using crafting_inventory() reach (Excerpt 1) returns true and opens the door.
